run_stable_diffusion_xl_inference: run the FlaxStableDiffusionXLPipeline to generate images from text prompts using JAX and Flax
prepare_prompt_inputs: prepare tokenized prompt inputs for both CLIP encoders using the prepare_inputs method
generate_images_with_classifier_free_gui: generate images using classifier-free guidance by concatenating unconditional and text embeddings in the denoising loop
get_text_embeddings: get concatenated prompt embeddings and pooled text embeddings from both text encoders using get_embeddings
run_parallel_generation_with_pmap: run parallel image generation across devices using the jax.pmap decorated _p_generate function
